verdicts.action: Invest in app stability and fix crashes, freezes, and loading bugs.
verdicts.comment: Multiple reviews mention login failures, app not opening, songs not playing, and now playing issues.

verdicts.action: Reduce ad frequency for free users and ensure premium users have an ad-free experience.
evidence: Ads on podcasts for premium users
verdicts.comment: Users complain about ad frequency and premium ads.

verdicts.action: Improve playback reliability including shuffle algorithm and track selection.
verdicts.comment: Users report shuffle issues, songs not playing, and missing tracks.

verdicts.action: Restore missing features like song previews, repeat playlist, and seek bar on Android Auto.
evidence: Cannot repeat playlist or songs anymore
verdicts.comment: Song previews and repeat playlist are mentioned; seek bar on Android Auto not mentioned in reviews.

verdicts.action: Enhance login and offline mode to prevent data usage and login errors.
verdicts.comment: Login errors are mentioned, but offline mode and data usage not explicitly discussed.

summary: Three recommendations are fully supported by user feedback: app stability, ad reduction, and playback reliability. Two are weakly supported: missing features (except seek bar) and login issues. Overall strong alignment.
